title: Lien Release Fees for Michigan and Pennsylvania Titles — Home Purchase Financing Payoffs
content:
**Title department fee note — Home Purchase Financing payoffs**

The lien release fee included in a payoff amount depends on the state whose title the home carries, which follows the community of the home's site as the borrower's Home-Site Lease shows it.

Where the home's site is in Cedar Hollow, the lien release fee for releasing the lien on the home's Michigan title is 15.00; where it is in Conestoga Meadows, the lien release fee for the Pennsylvania title is 58.00. For a site in any other community this note sets no lien release fee.

| Community of the home's site (from the Home-Site Lease) | Title state | Lien release fee (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| Cedar Hollow | Michigan | 15.00 |
| Conestoga Meadows | Pennsylvania | 58.00 |
| any other community | — | not set by this note |

*Hypothetical case.* A payoff on a home in Conestoga Meadows includes a lien release fee of 58.00; the same payoff on a home in Cedar Hollow includes 15.00.
